title.purpose: Contact name on the detail page.

components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-primary{font-family:-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Text', 'Helvetica Neue', sans-serif;min-height:44px;padding:10px 20px;border:none;border-radius:12px;background:#0a84ff;color:#fff;font-size:15px;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;transition:opacity .15s,transform .1s} .ds-btn-primary:hover{filter:brightness(1.06)} .ds-btn-primary:active{transform:scale(.97)} .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible{outline:3px solid rgba(10,132,255,.45);outline-offset:2px}

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary actions such as Back or Edit.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost{font-family:-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Text', 'Helvetica Neue', sans-serif;min-height:44px;padding:10px 16px;border:1px solid #d1d1d6;border-radius:10px;background:#e5e5ea;color:#0a84ff;font-size:15px;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer} .ds-btn-ghost:hover{background:#fff;border-color:#6c6c70} .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible{outline:3px solid rgba(10,132,255,.45);outline-offset:2px}

components.name: Text Input
components.css: .ds-input{font-family:-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Text', 'Helvetica Neue', sans-serif;width:100%;padding:12px 16px;background:#e5e5ea;border:1px solid #d1d1d6;border-radius:12px;color:#1c1c1e;font-size:16px;outline:none} .ds-input::placeholder{color:#6c6c70} .ds-input:focus{border-color:#0a84ff}

components.name: Tab Bar
components.css: .ds-tabbar{font-family:-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Text', 'Helvetica Neue', sans-serif;display:flex;border-top:1px solid #d1d1d6;background:#fff} .ds-tab{flex:1;min-height:56px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:11px;font-weight:500;color:#6c6c70} .ds-tab.active{color:#0a84ff}

narrative.overview: A ledger is read, not admired. Every contact is a row of facts and the interface exists to put the right fact under the thumb quickly. Flat, ruled surfaces, one blue accent, system type.
keyCharacteristics: Flat surfaces separated by 1px borders; depth through tone, not shadow.
One accent color, used only for actionable and active elements.
System font stack, hierarchy through weight and size.
44px minimum touch targets; navigation reachable by thumb on mobile.
Skeletons and states that mirror the final layout.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Signal Blue marks what can be acted on or what is current. If a blue element is neither, remove the blue.

rules.name: The Contrast Floor Rule
rules.body: Secondary text on a surface must keep at least 4.5:1.

rules.name: The Short Caps Rule
rules.body: Uppercase is reserved for section labels of four words or fewer.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Cards, rows and inputs carry no shadow at rest or on hover.

dos: Do keep every touch target at 44px or larger, and keep primary navigation at the bottom on mobile.
Do use Signal Blue (#0a84ff) only for actionable or active elements.
Do separate surfaces with a 1px Hairline border and a tone shift.
Do make loading, empty and error states mirror the real layout.
Do keep secondary text at 4.5:1 or better in both themes.
donts: Don't build a heavy corporate CRM: no endless forms, deep menus or visual noise.
Don't use generic template SaaS patterns: identical card grids, gradients, hero metrics.
Don't make it a decorative or childish app: no illustrations, emoji or animation that gets in the way of work.
Don't add shadows to cards, rows or inputs; the floating add button is the only exception.
Don't use border-left greater than 1px as a colored accent stripe on rows or cards.
Don't use gradient text or glass effects as decoration.
Don't use a generic spinning icon for loading; use a skeleton that matches the layout.
